nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) of token balances in ERC20; mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of allowances in ERC20; mutated by approve, increaseAllowance, decreaseAllowance, transferFrom and _burnFrom.
Private uint256 total token supply in ERC20; mutated by _mint and _burn.
Roles.Role private storage of minter role bearers in MinterRole; mutated by _addMinter and _removeMinter.
Caller-controlled address used as the implicit from/owner in transfer, transferFrom, approve, increaseAllowance, decreaseAllowance, burn, burnFrom, renounceMinter and the MinterRole constructor.
Public NewLGO function that loops over parallel arrays and delegates each element pair to mint; mints tokens for many accounts in one transaction.
Public NewLGO function that loops over parallel arrays and delegates each element pair to transfer; moves tokens to many accounts in one transaction.
ERC20Mintable public mint guarded by onlyMinter; mints value tokens to to via _mint.
ERC20 public transfer that moves tokens from msg.sender to to via _transfer.
ERC20 public transferFrom that decrements the caller allowance in _allowed and then calls _transfer from from to to.
ERC20 internal routine that subtracts from _balances[from] and adds to _balances[to]; central balance-mutating primitive.
ERC20 internal routine that increases _totalSupply and credits _balances[account] with newly created tokens.
ERC20 internal routine that decreases _totalSupply and debits _balances[account], destroying tokens.
ERC20 internal routine that first reduces the caller allowance in _allowed and then calls _burn for the target account.
ERC20 public function writing the caller allowance into _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
ERC20 public function adding addedValue to the caller allowance in _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
ERC20 public function subtracting subtractedValue from the caller allowance in _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
ERC20Burnable public function burning the caller balance through _burn(msg.sender, value).
ERC20Burnable public function burning from a target account through _burnFrom(from, value).
MinterRole public function guarded by onlyMinter that grants the minter role through _addMinter.
MinterRole public function that revokes the caller minter role through _removeMinter(msg.sender).
MinterRole public view function reading _minters to decide whether an account holds the minter role; used by the onlyMinter modifier.
MinterRole internal function that writes true into _minters for an account and emits MinterAdded.
MinterRole internal function that writes false into _minters for an account and emits MinterRemoved.
MinterRole constructor that grants the minter role to msg.sender by calling _addMinter at deployment time.
Allowance-exempt subtraction of value from _balances[from] inside _transfer, relying on SafeMath.sub for underflow protection.
Addition of value into _balances[to] inside _transfer, relying on SafeMath.add for overflow protection.
Subtraction of value from _allowed[from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom, relying on SafeMath.sub for underflow protection.
Addition of value into _totalSupply inside _mint, relying on SafeMath.add for overflow protection.
Unbounded for-loop over accounts.length in bulkMint indexing both arrays and calling mint per iteration.
Unbounded for-loop over accounts.length in bulkTransfer indexing both arrays and calling transfer per iteration.
address[] memory accounts input parameter of bulkMint listing the receivers of minted tokens.
uint256[] memory values input parameter of bulkMint with the amounts to mint, indexed in parallel with accounts.
Loop counter uint i in bulkMint used to index both accounts and values.
address[] memory accounts input parameter of bulkTransfer listing the token recipients.
uint256[] memory values input parameter of bulkTransfer with the amounts to send, indexed in parallel with accounts.
Loop counter uint i in bulkTransfer used to index both accounts and values.
address to parameter of mint, the account receiving newly minted tokens.
uint256 value parameter of mint, the amount of tokens created.
address from parameter of _transfer, the account whose balance is debited.
address to parameter of _transfer, the account whose balance is credited.
uint256 value parameter of _transfer, the amount moved between balances.
address from parameter of transferFrom, the owner whose allowance and balance are used.
address to parameter of transferFrom, the recipient of the transferred tokens.
uint256 value parameter of transferFrom, the amount authorized and transferred.
address spender parameter of approve, the account receiving the allowance.
uint256 value parameter of approve, the allowance amount written to storage.
address account parameter of _mint, the beneficiary of the newly created tokens.
uint256 value parameter of _mint, the amount added to supply and balance.
address spender parameter of increaseAllowance.
uint256 addedValue parameter of increaseAllowance, added to the current allowance.
address spender parameter of decreaseAllowance.
uint256 subtractedValue parameter of decreaseAllowance, subtracted from the current allowance.
address account parameter of addMinter, the account granted the minter role.
address account parameter of _burn, the account whose tokens are destroyed.
uint256 value parameter of _burn, the amount removed from supply and balance.
uint256 value parameter of burn, the caller amount destroyed.
address from parameter of burnFrom, the account whose tokens are destroyed via allowance.
uint256 value parameter of burnFrom, the amount destroyed and deducted from allowance.

edges.reason: transfer uses msg.sender as the source address passed into _transfer.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key when decrementing _allowed.
approve writes the allowance under _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
increaseAllowance reads and writes _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
decreaseAllowance reads and writes _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
burn destroys the balance of msg.sender through _burn.
burnFrom consumes the caller allowance while burning from the target account.
renounceMinter removes the minter role from msg.sender.
MinterRole constructor grants the minter role to msg.sender, seeding privileged access from an externally controlled address.
bulkMint is public and delegates each element to the onlyMinter-guarded mint, so access restriction depends entirely on the callee.
bulkTransfer loops over the arrays and invokes transfer for each pair.
mint passes to and value into the internal _mint routine.
transfer forwards msg.sender, to and value into _transfer.
transferFrom calls _transfer after adjusting the allowance.

_transfer debits and credits the _balances mapping.
_mint credits the beneficiary balance in _balances.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_burn debits the account balance in _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_burnFrom subtracts from the _allowed allowance before burning.
_burnFrom delegates the actual destruction to _burn.

increaseAllowance adds addedValue into _allowed.
decreaseAllowance subtracts subtractedValue from _allowed.
burn delegates to _burn with msg.sender.
burnFrom delegates to _burnFrom with the target address.
addMinter grants the role by calling _addMinter.
renounceMinter revokes the role by calling _removeMinter.
_addMinter writes true into the _minters role storage.
_removeMinter writes false into the _minters role storage.

addMinter is guarded by the onlyMinter modifier which calls isMinter(msg.sender).

_transfer performs an addition on the to balance that depends on user-supplied value.

bulkTransfer executes an unbounded index loop whose counter is incremented by one each pass.
